title: EU Customs Calculator 2026: €3 Duty, €2 Fee & VAT | TDR
description: Model the EU charges on your eCommerce orders: the €3 duty per item, the €2 handling fee and the VAT effect. Updated for the rules in force since November 2026.
titleDesc: Discover how the €3 customs duty, the €2 handling fee and VAT affect your EU import costs.
orderValue: Is the order value €150 or less?
hsCodeCountHint: Items are counted by tariff classification (HS code), not by quantity. 5 T-shirts count as 1 item only if they all have exactly the same HS code; T-shirts with different HS codes count separately, and a T-shirt and a watch count as 2 items.
IOSS: Are you registered for IOSS for VAT payment?
Updated: Updated on November 23rd 2026: €2 EU handling fee added
fillForm: Fill in the form and the quantified impact will be displayed here.
promoTitle: Duty and VAT on returned goods can be refundable
promoDesc: The flat €3 duty and the €2 handling fee cannot be recovered, but customs duties and VAT paid on goods that are later returned or re-exported may be. Let TDR check what you are entitled to.
